multi_index.description: sequence of integer arrays containing indices in each dimension.

dims.description: sequence of integer sizes; must have ``len(dims) == len(multi_index)``

mode.description: how to handle out-of bound indices. Options are

with.description: func:`~jax.jit` or other JAX transformations. - ``"clip"``: clip out-of-bound indices to valid range. - ``"wrap"``: wrap out-of-bound indices to valid range. - ``"ignore"``: do not coerce or check input indices. Behavior is undefined if indices are out of bounds.

order.description: ``"C"`` (default) or ``"F"``, specify whether to assume C-style row-major order or Fortran-style column-major order. dtype: the desired output dtype. If not specified, the dtype is determined by standard type promotion rules of the input multi_index.
